articles.title: England Vs Argentina FIFA World Cup 2026 Semi-Final Live Score: All Eyes On Lionel Messi As Historic Rivalry Writes Latest Chapter
articles.description: England Vs Argentina FIFA World Cup 2026 Semi-Final Live Score: England and Argentina, prepare to write the next chapter of their fierce rivalry when they take on each other in the second semi-final of the FIFA World Cup 2026 at the Atlanta Stadium for a coveted spot in the final. After topping Group L with a statement 4-2 win over Croatia, Thomas Tuchel’s England side showed incredible resolve in the knockouts. They battled from a goal down to defeat Congo DR in the Round of 32, and survived a thrilling test against co-hosts Mexico, winning 3-2 with ten men. They then went past Norway in the quarter-final. Fuelled by Harry Kane and Jude Bellingham, who both have scored six goals, the Three Lions are roaring with belief. Following a flawless group stage, Lionel Scaloni’s Argentina relied on extra time to push past Cabo Verde, orchestrated a late comeback against Egypt, and outlasted Switzerland 3-1 in a grueling 120-minute quarter-final. A record-breaking Lionel Messi remains the heartbeat of a squad desperate to retain their global crown. He leads the Golden Boot charts with 8 goals. The victor will pack their bags for the grand finale on July 19, where they will face a formidable Spain side.
